observations.description: Shared-position stop/target coordinator: BTC spot long only, exactly one SELL pair, both active/unfilled, parent-order bound, stop<entry<target geometry, both-touched collision (stop wins), partial/zero/full fills, reconciliation-gated accounting, replay/gap/chronology latch, deterministic result, trading_authority=false.

Cancellation: requests alone don't establish, full exits require sibling, partial exits require both old orders cancelled, foreign bindings rejected, stale versions rejected, duplicate events rejected, backdated evidence rejected, fill_quantity in cancellation rejected, no silent rearm.

Persistence: exclusive writer lock (O_EXCL), CAS, deterministic replay, duplicate keys rejected, unsupported types rejected, non-finite values rejected, size limit, IN_FLIGHT/COMMITTED status, atomic temp+replace+fsync, corrupt checkpoint rejected.

Initial file: create-only persistence, reopen from directory, writer lock presence blocks open, already-exists rejects, initial-file/journal consistency, round-trip verification, unsafe path rejection.

Replacement: requires CANCELLED_REQUIRES_REARM state, exact remaining quantity, fresh identities, predecessor mapping, price grids, unchanged risk/execution terms, stale/future/ineligible source rejected, rearm_authorized=false, requires_gap_review=true, trading_authority=false.
Integration: full offline sequence (initialize→evaluate→ack→cancel_ack→reopen) and full-exit sequence through durable journal with disk reload.
No network/credential/broker/exchange/wallet/signing/submission imports. trading_authority=false throughout. os imported for atomic file operations only.
